plain: The denial or opposite of something

webster.text: Denial; a declaration that something is not; opposed to affirmation; as, the soul is not matter.

example.quote: as would be equal to a general negation, such as his honorable friend (Mr.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
